def resid_for(w, extra=True):
    base=[]
    for i in [1,2]:
        base.append(P**i)
        base.append(P**i*np.sin(w*t)); base.append(P**i*np.cos(w*t))
        if extra: base.append(P**i*t)
    base.append(np.ones_like(t)); base.append(np.sin(w*t)); base.append(np.cos(w*t)); base.append(t)
    A=np.column_stack(base)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((dP_dt-A@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c
best=[]
